author: NoobMaster69
content: Hey everyone - new member here. I've been sitting on a Sunshine glitch for a while and haven't seen anything else like it. By mounting Yoshi in a tight gap in Pinna Park and then rotating the camera, Mario gets teleported far below the map into an underwater area. Since the teleportation is triggered by the camera position, I thought it might reveal some unusual engine or camera behaviors useful for reverse-engineering. Happy to answer any questions if needed. Here's a short video (recorded from SM3DAS): https://files.catbox.moe/ec9vxe.mp4
